english.title: Drive / ride vehicle constructed / used for trade/ business in a Royal Park - Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Reg's 97

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Regulations 1997

english.standardoffencewording:

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 4(27) of the Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Regulations 1997 and section 2 of the Parks Regulation (Amendment) Act 1926.

english.notes:
(i) Regulations 5 and 6 provide for powers of constables to require a person to state his name and address.
(ii) Schedule 2 to the Royal Parks and Other Open Spaces Regulations 1997 lists the vehicles that may be used on park roads and the speeds at which they may be driven.
